stories.title: New Delhi scripts a post-US worldview
stories.summary: The New Delhi Declaration signifies a transformative shift in global dynamics, asserting a multipolar world that transcends Western dominance. BRICS stands against unilateral sanctions, branding them as coercive actions that undermine legitimacy. This unified stance underscores the importance of sovereignty and dialogue while highlighting a move towards strategic autonomy. India's advocacy for UNSC reform further supports this newly conceived worldview, as BRICS actively engages with the shifting global landscape.

stories.title: Tighter US Visa isn't all that bad for India
stories.summary: Stricter visa regulations in foreign nations will intensify competition for India's skilled workforce. Additionally, numerous students are burdened with unmanageable debt due to the high costs of studying abroad. The imposition of job entry barriers in Western countries is hindering immigrant students, prompting universities to consider establishing more campuses overseas. As a result, India may see a reverse brain drain supported by the rise of global competency centers.
